scope: Necessary stock-identity evidence; not sufficient for matched TMD panel admission. No proposed experiment or material selection.

required_evidence.record: Versioned repository identifier, aliases and accession or custody history explicitly connecting the claimed physical stock to the named source isolate or reconstruction.
Original isolate versus reconstructed allele; if reconstructed, the specific reconstruction identifier and documented parent background.
Sequence accession/version plus gene model or annotation release, strand and coordinate basis used for the allele label.
Sequence or variant-call evidence linked to this stock, with source provenance and validation status; a generic reference sequence or matching allele label is insufficient.
Source-backed handling of the awsX 32bp/33nt and mwsR V272A/V728A labels, keeping original literals and any author correction distinct.
Documented relevant background differences and markers; shared SBW25 naming alone does not establish equivalence.

downstream_admission_still_requires: acquisition episodes and independent origin truth
